section: Bengal - Murshid Quli Khan to Siraj-ud-Daula; Black Hole episode; Battle of Plassey (1757)

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes the historical significance of the Battle of Plassey?
o: It marked the beginning of British political control in India and enabled Bengal revenue to finance later British conquests
It transferred the capital of the British settlements from Madras to Calcutta
It brought Mysore under British control for the first time
It ended the Mughal Empire and established direct British rule over all of India
accepted.x: Plassey is regarded as the beginning of British political control in India. The revenues of Bengal subsequently helped finance further British conquests.
accepted.tq: Identify the broad historical consequence rather than confusing it with the outcome of a later conquest.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the events associated with the Battle of Plassey:
1. The British political ascendancy that followed Plassey was connected with the revenues of Bengal.
2. The revenues of Bengal helped finance subsequent British conquests.
3. Plassey is generally characterised as an open military victory without any conspiracy.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because Plassey is characterised as a conspiracy, whereas Buxar is described as an open military victory.
accepted.tq: Separate the financial consequence of Plassey from the contrasting character of Plassey and Buxar.

accepted.s:
The conspiracy associated with the Battle of Plassey involved Clive's deal with which of the following persons or groups?
1. Jagat Seth
2. Omichund
3. Mir Jafar
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: 1 only
1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: The deal associated with Clive's conspiracy at Plassey involved Jagat Seth, Omichund and Mir Jafar.
accepted.tq: Use the named-person cluster to distinguish the conspiracy at Plassey from a straightforward battlefield victory.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly distinguishes the Battles of Plassey and Buxar?
o: Plassey is associated with conspiracy, whereas Buxar is associated with an open military victory
Plassey was an open military victory, whereas Buxar was based on a conspiracy
Both Plassey and Buxar were exclusively diplomatic victories without military involvement
Both battles were fought to end the British political presence in Bengal
accepted.x: Plassey is characterised as a conspiracy, while Buxar is characterised as an open military victory. This distinction is central to the debate over which battle was more decisive.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-comparison trap by fixing the distinctive character of each battle.

accepted.s: Which of the following issues is specifically associated with the continuing historical debate concerning the Black Hole episode?
o: The identity of the last Subedar of Bengal
The number of persons involved in the episode
The location of the Plassey battlefield
The year in which the Battle of Buxar was fought
accepted.x: The numbers associated with the Black Hole episode remain a subject of historical criticism and debate. The other alternatives concern separate facts and do not represent the stated controversy.
accepted.tq: Find the precise issue under debate rather than selecting an unrelated Plassey fact.

accepted.s: The 269th anniversary of the Battle of Plassey was noted in which month and year?
o: July 2025
June 2025
July 2026
June 2026
accepted.x: The 269th anniversary of Plassey was noted in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the anniversary number with its stated month and year without shifting the date by one year.
